name: SmartCity Civic Platform
description: A modern AI-enabled civic issue reporting platform that allows citizens to report potholes, garbage issues, water leakages, traffic problems, and public infrastructure complaints while enabling authorities to monitor, manage, and resolve complaints efficiently in real time.

features.title: Citizen Reporting
features.description: Citizens can report civic issues with location, images, and detailed descriptions.

features.title: Admin Management
features.description: Authorities can manage complaints, update statuses, and monitor issue resolution.

features.title: Live Tracking
features.description: Users can track complaint progress through detailed timelines and updates.

features.title: Interactive Maps
features.description: Complaints are displayed on real-time city maps for better monitoring.

features.title: Smart AI Assistant
features.description: Integrated local AI assistant helps citizens and administrators navigate the platform.
